headline: As of 2026-11-03: 61,487,685 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.0 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 61,487,685 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.0 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,884,552), Florida (6,748,398), California (6,481,962).
